thread:
Alex Chen: quick async standup — kernel / batching / KV cache notes

Priya Nair: Yesterday: landed the microbatch backpressure fix (patch -> main). Observed 8% p99 token latency drop on small seq workloads.

Alex Chen: Nice! Did you run the 2k sequence perf run?

Priya Nair: ran a quick pass: `./bench --model gpt-small --seq 2048 --bsize 4` — replication pending but numbers look stable. Putting full logs in the bench bucket.

Zane Ortiz: Yesterday: split the batching scheduler changes into two PRs — one for metrics, one for queue semantics. Blocker: need a runtime hook for draining during canary. Pinged @deploy-bot for canary window.

Maria Gomez: Yesterday: experimented with weighted KV eviction (LRU + recency score). Results: hit-rate up ~6% for chat-sim traces, but cold-start token latency regressed slightly.

Alex Chen: For the cold-start regression, can you share the trace that regressed? I can try a quick KV-prefetch tweak — small heuristic to warm frequent prefixes.

Maria Gomez: posted trace: link to S3 -> s3://redwood-bench/traces/199999/tr1.log. Also added brief note in the PR about an opt-in flag `--prefetch-window`.

Priya Nair: Quick ask: does the new scheduler metrics expose per-model queue length? I'm trying to correlate queue vs p99.

Zane Ortiz: yes, `runtime.scheduler.queue_len{model}` is emitted. I'll add a dashboard panel to the kernel perf board.

CI Bot: Build #4721 passed for PR 8345 — all tests green.

Alex Chen: Today: I'll prototype a tiny prefetch heuristic (rank top-5 prefixes from recent history) and run microbench. If it shows improvements I'll open a draft PR.

Priya Nair: Today: run full seq-2k bench and then re-run with Maria's eviction tweak to compare.

Zane Ortiz: Today: add the drain hook + dashboard panel, then request review for the metrics PR.

Maria Gomez: Today: try `--prefetch-window=128` and sweep cache params; will annotate perf diffs in the PR.

Alex Chen: Blockers: need a final signoff on the canary policy for kernel changes (SLOs + fallback). @Priya can you ack once bench completes?

Priya Nair: Ack — will report within 3 hours.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 03:30 UTC if no blockers reported. :eyes:

Zane Ortiz: tiny FYI — saw a spike in tokenization overhead on the 2k run, likely due to a tokenizer cache miss. Will dig in.

Maria Gomez: If tokenizer cache is noisy, might be worth adding a short-lived cache shard to reduce lock contention.

Alex Chen: thanks all. If anything urgent ping me DMed or @channel. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: quick note — sharing a short snippet of the bench command for reproducibility:
```
./bench --model gpt-small --seq 2048 --batch 4 --traces s3://redwood-bench/traces/199999/ --out results/199999.json
```

Zane Ortiz: lgtm — will add the queue_len panel to the perf dashboard and tag you.

CI Bot: Reminder: nightly integration tests start at 02:00 UTC.

Alex Chen: End of thread — thanks everyone.
